notes.title: Updated [ver1.0.2]
notes.notes:
Update contents:
-Supported Steam achievements.
-The skill or equipment switching can be done with the Z or X keys.
-A jump ramp added to the stage edit.
-Adjusted the effects when the stage started.
-Changed some UI in the game.
-Changed some graphics in the stage edit.
-Supported Windows 32bit.
-Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Updated [ver1.0.1]
notes.notes:
Update contents:
-Adjusted the effects when the stage is cleared and when it fails.
-Added stage floor pattern.
-Changed some graphics in the game.
-Added help to the pause screen in the game.
-Other minor fixes.

notes.title: "Ninja Castle Escape" is out now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Use your creativity and [i]ninjutsu[/i] skills to escape from the booby trapped castle. 
Your goal is to lead the ninja to a successful escape.
Including a Stage Editor to share castle designs with others in Steam Workshop for endless fun. 

Ninja Castle Escape starts now!

For more about the game check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387450/]here[/url].

Thank you!
